message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 122, "amount_cents": 5470}, {"order_id": 124, "amount_cents": 1085}]
Refunds requested in this batch (from the batch order, signed by Alpha): [{"order_id": 121, "amount_cents": 5261}, {"order_id": 122, "amount_cents": 5470}, {"order_id": 124, "amount_cents": 1085}]
The batch is now with you.
hold_reason: Refund for order 121 (amount_cents 5261) is requested in the batch but is missing from the refunds table. The table contains only order 122 (5470) and order 124 (1085). W2 reported only 122 and 124 as applied. No payouts recorded. Needs human review of the order 121 refund before the batch is paid.

reply.thought: The batch requests three refunds, but W2 reported only two as applied. I need to check the refunds table directly before deciding whether to hold.
The refunds table has only orders 122 and 124. Order 121's refund of 5261 cents, which the batch requests, is missing. The instructions say to hold in this case, before any payouts are recorded.
